info.name: Crusoe Cloud API Gateway Audit Logs Projects API
Retrieve details about projects that the logged in user belongs to or owns.

items.docs: If querying for projects within an organization, the logged in user must be the owner of the organization.

info.name: Create a new project that will be owned by the logged in user.

items.docs:
The logged in user must have the permission to create projects within the organization.
A successful response from this resource contains details of the created project.

info.name: Update details for a project that the logged in user owns.

items.docs:
Requests to this resource must contain the json-encoded representation of the changes they want to make to the project.
Currently only the project's name can be changed.

info.name: Retrieve details about a project that the logged in user belongs to or owns.

items.docs: Retrieve details about a project that the logged in user belongs to or owns.

info.name: Delete a project that the logged in user owns.

items.docs: Delete operations cascade to VMs created under that project.
